entities.summary: Engelbrekt Church is a protected church located in the Lärkstaden area of Stockholm, Sweden. It belongs to the Church of Sweden and is a parish church for Engelbrekt Parish in the Diocese of Stockholm. It was designed by architect Lars Israel Wahlman in the National Romantic style and completed in 1914. It is one of the largest churches in Stockholm, with 1,400 seats.
